coordinates.native: X right, -Y forward, Z up; HeadRoot origin eye line
coordinates.generated: Per-eye undeformed primitive local AABB normalized 0..1. Do not use world coordinates or post-skin world normals.
coordinates.uv_reconstruction_stage: Prefer vertex-stage reconstruction and interpolate Generated to fragment, matching native ORCO interpolation over the actual sphere triangles.
coordinates.gltf_uv: Blender 4.5 exporter writes (u,1-v_blender); reconstruct v_blender=1-UV.y when importer preserves glTF TEXCOORD_0. Confirm once on actual exported eyes.

L.material: Eye.L / spherical iris, pupil and painted glints

actual_node_audit.material: Eye.L / spherical iris, pupil and painted glints

ramps.label: Measured deep navy to muted blue layers

R.material: Eye.R / spherical iris, pupil and painted glints

actual_node_audit.material: Eye.R / spherical iris, pupil and painted glints

ramps.label: Measured deep navy to muted blue layers

iris_algorithm.output: Unshaded/emission linear RGB on true closed eye sphere, cull back, no next-pass outline

helpers.soft_range: Clamped smoothstep map, not a hard disc

iris_algorithm.center_and_units: cx/cz=eyes[side].generated_center; all per-layer offsets and radii in metres divide by eye diameter before using Generated
iris_algorithm.glint_order: Use eyes[side].glints after halo/pupil. Upper two broad overlapping ovals, lower-inner tiny reflection, then restrained flecks.
sequence: mix over sclera with front iris mask

skin.material: Face / editable albedo and gentle NPR
skin.color_space: Source FLOAT_COLOR .color values are linear. Carry glTF COLOR_0 as linear; convert sRGB hex constants once.
skin.base_rule: Only on the final normalized artifact whose manifest declares vertexAlbedoRule=replace: Face COLOR_0 is FaceAlbedo and Lips COLOR_0 is LipAlbedo. They REPLACE fallback albedo, never multiply by fixed skin RGB. Raw v7 COLOR_0 is white and must first be remapped by the assembler.

rest_surface_paint.coordinate: Unchanging head rest x,z,depth, not world position after Jaw/gaze. Source Generated head AABB maps back to rest x/z.

skin.shade_rule: Source NPR is diffuse-white -> ShaderToRGB -> EASE ramp -> MULTIPLY albedo -> emission. Preserve vertex albedo through runtime cel shading; do not overwrite it with generic uniform calibration.

actual_node_audit.material: Face / editable albedo and gentle NPR

labelled_mix_layers.label: Tiny painted nose-tip light on the real nose

lip_rule.central_gap: Mask creates two short interrupted mouth strokes.
lip_rule.export_requirement: Final assembler remaps the native LipAlbedo accessor (raw v7 COLOR_2) to standard COLOR_0 on the Lips primitive, and FaceAlbedo (raw v7 COLOR_1) on the Face primitive. Verify the normalized artifact audit/manifest; do not read nonexistent COLOR_1 shader APIs. Oral interior retains its own material.

raw_gltf_observation.artifact: Root actual audit of complete v7 GLB, not the frozen native .blend
raw_gltf_observation.warning: Named native attributes do not automatically become semantic COLOR_0. Never pretend Godot has a standard COLOR_1 shader input.

normalized_artifact_contract.Face / material: COLOR_0 accessor replaced with the native FaceAlbedo accessor (raw v7 COLOR_1)
normalized_artifact_contract.Lips / material: COLOR_0 accessor replaced with the native LipAlbedo accessor (raw v7 COLOR_2)
normalized_artifact_contract.Mouth / material: Keep oral-interior material; do not apply the skin replacement or generic skin calibration
normalized_artifact_contract.binary_buffer: Unmodified; accessor references remapped in glTF metadata
normalized_artifact_contract.manifest_contract: vertexAlbedoRule=replace plus actual final artifact audit. Only this normalized final artifact guarantees COLOR_0 semantics.

ink_geometry.outline_policy: Source face-v4 has no inverted hull outline. Lashes/lids/brows/lip ink are already real volume/material; disable additional outline on these meshes and eye globes.

brow.path: x=eye_center_x+mix(-.12,.12,t); z=(.178 L/.188 R)+.015*sin(pi*t)+sad*(.043*(t L/1-t R)-.005)+.010*smile; depth=front_depth(x,z)+.008

outer_wing.path_offset: sign*.030*t in x; (.031*t+.006*sin(pi*t))*(1-.35*blink) in z; +.004 front

rig.evaluation_order: Morph deltas in native mesh local space, then standard skeleton skinning. Do not double-apply Jaw to already-skinned morph output.

weights.blink_sphere_inbetween: 4*b*(1-b); required to follow globe at half blink
weights.squintL_R: Independent 0..1 neutral-asymmetry skin controls; do not bake source perspective into rest apertures.

rig.ocular_mapping: Use actual Eye.L/R native rest basis matrices. Native local Euler driver X=.20*gazeY; Z=.30*gazeX, Y locked. Convert basis to Godot once; do not guess global rotation axes.
rig.jaw_mapping: Use actual driver expression and Jaw rest basis below; angle limits local X ±.26, local Y/Z locked for Jaw. Tongue driver is real bone X=.035*aa.

runtime_acceptance: Verify L/R-specific iris parameters on actual v8 eye surfaces, with downward blue-white petals and broad upper catchlights not vertically flipped.
Compare native face-v4 context front/threequarter/side under consistent light; generic v2 iris or uniform skin does not count as v4 look transfer.
Actual GPU readback at blink 0,.25,.5,.75,1 with smile/sad/squint and gaze; preserve all corrective targets.
Test real Jaw/phoneme and upper/lower teeth/tongue skinning; closed soft smile has no automatic white teeth slit.
Check cull/outline separately; no duplicate hull around already-solid lash ink.
Do not treat shader parse success or numeric closure as artistic acceptance.
